PelaAI's released KnowLine-4B-Gen5.5 (PelaAI/KnowLine-4B-Gen5.5 at 779944d), a merged LoRA fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B (the average of two) whose weights are those of Gen5. It ran on our hardware (one DGX Spark), one request at a time, through the card's serve_knowline.sh (SGLang 0.5.21 with the weights quantised to FP8 at load, and the repository's knowline_server.py, which reads a request of up to 3,000 tokens twice), with vision on. Its card lists English and Chinese.

Latency: the time from sending one request to receiving its answer, measured from our computer, network and any retries within the request included. Request time: the time at least one request was in flight, over the requests whose answers were kept. It is not the run's elapsed time: it leaves out requests that failed and any pause before a run was resumed.
